title: AI coach
description: Chat with a coach that designs your plan and reviews your progress, using your own AI key.

notConnected.title: Connect your own AI key to use the coach
notConnected.body: The coach interviews you, designs a plan around your goals and injuries, and helps you adjust it as you go. Everything else in FitPower works without AI.

header.clearConfirm: Clear the whole conversation? This can't be undone.

keyDialog.title: Connect your AI key
keyDialog.description: Your key stays in this browser. It is sent only to the provider you choose, only when you chat with the coach, and it is never included in backups.
keyDialog.modelHint: Any model your key can use that supports tool calling.
keyDialog.baseUrlHint: For local servers: Ollama is http://localhost:11434/v1, LM Studio is http://localhost:1234/v1.
keyDialog.privacyBody: When you send a message, the coach receives your profile, your active plan and a summary of your progress so it can give personal advice. Your photos never leave this device.
keyDialog.removed: AI key removed from this browser

errors.baseUrl: Enter a full URL, starting with http:// or https://.

settingsCard.title: AI coach
settingsCard.notConnected: Not connected. FitPower works fully offline; the coach is optional.
settingsCard.keepNote: You can remove the key after your plan is made, or keep it to keep chatting with the coach.

chat.label: Conversation with the coach
chat.placeholder: Ask about your plan, progress or a workout…
chat.stoppedEarly: I stopped before finishing that. Say "continue" and I'll pick it up.
chat.emptyBody: I already know your profile from setup. Tell me what you'd like, or pick a starting point.

starters.planText: Please design a training plan for me. Ask me anything you need first.
starters.progressText: How is my progress going? What should I focus on this week?
starters.swapText: I'm short on energy today. How can I adjust today's workout?

chat.scope: The coach only helps with fitness, nutrition and this app. It isn't a doctor.

errors.auth: Your provider rejected the key. Check it in AI key settings.
errors.rate-limit: Your provider is rate-limiting requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.network: Couldn't reach your AI provider. Check your internet connection (or that your local server is running).
errors.bad-response: Your provider couldn't handle the request. Check the model name supports tool calling.
errors.server: Your AI provider had a problem. Try again in a moment.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong talking to the coach.

proposal.fitLength: {{session}} runs about {{minutes}} min; your profile says {{max}} min.
proposal.changesPrefill: I'd like to change the plan:
proposal.savedToast: New plan saved. It starts on {{start}}.
proposal.saveError: Couldn't save the plan. Try again.
proposal.acceptedNote: The user accepted the proposed plan "{{name}}". It is now the active plan.
proposal.profileAcceptedNote: The user accepted the profile change ({{fields}}).
proposal.profileDismissedNote: The user declined the profile change ({{fields}}).
